component.name: Docker Panel
component.summary: Manage the containers and compose projects on your machine
Gerencie os containers e projetos compose da sua máquina

description.p: A panel for every Docker container on your machine, grouped by compose project, from any folder.

ul.li: Start, stop, take down and restart whole compose projects
Start, stop and restart single containers
Open a terminal in any running container, in tabs
Published ports and mounted projects become clickable links

description.p: Requires Docker installed on the host, with your user allowed to access the Docker socket.
